Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Stripe Product Accounting Team is responsible for supporting all products at Stripe, consulting on accounting implications and supporting teams' ability to make informed strategic decisions. We are responsible for the accurate and timely recording of all business-generated transactions on our balance sheet and income statement. We operate in a fast-paced environment and collaborate significantly with cross-functional and international teams. 

What you’ll do

Stripe is seeking an experienced accountant to join its world class Accounting team and help us scale for the future, in a fast-paced environment that is growing rapidly. In this role you will support our Payments and Payment Products revenue accounting, leveraging your technical expertise with US GAAP, specifically ASC 606, to quickly identify accounting implications and impacts to customers while advising and collaborating with team members cross-functionally to develop operational processes that help us scale.

 

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with our product, go-to-market, and finance partners to thoroughly understand new products, features, and contracts.
  • To leverage your familiarity with US GAAP, specifically ASC 606 (IFRS 15 acceptable), and in-depth understanding of the transaction level processes, to quickly identify the accounting implications of proposed contract terms and product design and collaborate with team members to provide solutions that meet all stakeholders’ objectives
  • Partner closely with our product, go-to-market, and finance partners to thoroughly understand new products, features, and contracts
  • You will be responsible for documenting the Company’s accounting positions and communicating them to varying levels in the organization
  • Partner with internal systems and engineering teams to support internal financial systems and automation of accounting processes
  • Assess the effectiveness of internal controls, and design new processes and controls for emerging and growing business activities
  • Develop and maintain up-to-date accounting procedural documentation
  • Understand balance sheet reconciliations, variance analyses, financial reporting deliverables, and perform analytical reviews
  • Produce internal management analyses and reporting
  • Support external audit processes

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • An accountancy qualification (e.g. CA, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA) with 3 - 6 years of relevant accounting experience
  • Degree in Accounting or Finance background
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP - ASC 606 (or IFRS 15)
  • The ability to bring structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity and thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong analytical skills and strong knowledge of Google Sheets / Excel
  • An enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality
  • A passion for creating new systems and solving problems via infrastructure and automation
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and with different cultures
  • Demonstrated experience with internal controls
  • Ability to be flexible and comfortable with changing requirements

Preferred qualifications

  • CPA/ CA or similar qualification
  • Technical expertise with US GAAP, specifically ASC 606/IFRS 15
  • Knowledge of (or experience in) the technology or payments industry
  • Experience working with Oracle Suite, SalesForce
  • Experience with Hubble and SQL
  • Experience with Analytical Tools like- Power BI, Tableau, KNIME, Python, Alteryx

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Toast is driven by building a platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. Our Finance team serves as a trusted advisor to the company, guiding critical business decisions through insightful analyses & thought partnership with executive leaders.

We are seeking an R&D Finance associate to own key aspects of our financial reporting, monthly and quarterly processes, and support critical planning activities within our R&D Finance & Strategy team. In this role, you’ll contribute to the foundation of our finance operations as we advance as a public company, with a focus on enhancing efficiency through process improvements and automation. You’ll work closely with our R&D and Corporate Finance team, and collaborate across functions to deliver essential insights and drive strategic initiatives for our senior R&D leaders.

A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)

• Support Toast’s monthly and quarterly financial close processes for the R&D function, including reporting and analysis of budget vs. actual results, forecast updates, and preparation of standard financial packages that provide actionable insights for R&D leadership. 
• Own headcount tracking, reporting, and reconciliation activities for R&D, conducting trend analysis and collaborating closely with Finance, R&D leadership, and Talent Acquisition to align resource planning with strategic priorities. 
• Oversee the financial management for the R&D vendor portfolio, including PO and invoice reconciliation, variance analysis, and trend reporting to ensure alignment with budget and financial goals. 
• Leverage Toast’s financial systems, tools, and datasets to build and maintain standard reports and analyses, identifying opportunities to improve insight depth and forecast accuracy, specifically tailored to R&D’s unique needs and objectives. 
• Assess and refine existing financial processes for R&D, implementing automation and standardization initiatives to reduce manual workload and create efficiencies across the finance team. 
• Partner closely with cross-functional teams, to research, analyze, and advise on financial processes and reporting that directly support R&D’s innovation, operational, and financial goals. 
• Able to work 2 pm - 11 pm IST

What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)

• 4+ years of work experience in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, private equity, business operations or accounting
• Strong analytical skills including financial modeling, data/trend analysis and manipulation of large datasets, with proven ability to summarize complex data into key takeaways
• Highly proficient in advanced Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides
• Experience working with financial systems, such as WorkDay, Adaptive, Greenhouse, NetSuite, or other similar products
• Positive attitude with high aptitude to learn new things quickly. Team player eager to further develop and grow with us
• Demonstrates intellectual curiosity, problem-solving skills, and hunger to continually up-level current approaches and processes
• Strong ability to work in a collaborative, diverse, inclusive, and open-minded office environment with a desire to contribute to a thriving culture 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

a9aeab0c4b610aa5.description:
Role: Head of Engineering
Company: xpate
Location: London or remote
Job Type: Full-time

About xpate
xpate has been a card acquirer since 2019. It combines acquiring and banking for B2B clients only, with €100M+ in annual revenue. About 100 people work there, around 15 of them in engineering. HQ is in London, and the team is spread across Latvia, Cyprus, Serbia and Singapore.
The business is changing. xpate is moving from direct sales to distribution through platforms and partners: embedded finance and Payfac-as-a-Service. The platform has to change with it. Tooling, data flow, processes and the release cycle all need a rebuild, and much of the workflow is still tracked by hand.
xpate also wants to become AI-native. Guardrails go around the core – the data layer and financial data – so it can’t be lost, rewritten or broken. Everything else runs through an agentic harness on top, so non-engineering teams can build their own tools by prompting agents.

What you will do
• 
Lead the platform and organizational transformation from the inside, together with the current team.
• 
Own the whole technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors.
• 
Replace the traditional PM → engineer handoff. Test the idea that engineering and product can work as one, with engineers talking directly to the business and domain experts.
• 
Move code writing to LLMs with automated QA. Start where mistakes are cheap and reach the critical financial components later.
• 
Hire engineers who talk to people and ask questions, not only write code. You can bring in 1–2 people who share the vision.
• 
Focus on internal efficiency. The business sets the direction – the job is not to set a product or market vision of your own.
First 6 months
• 
Months 1–3: bring all data flow – customer, financial and manual – into one clear perimeter.
• 
Months 4–6: build the harness on top, so non-engineering teams can prompt agents, create their own tools and run their workflows.

What you need to succeed
• 
You have built financial systems: ledger, reconciliation, processing, gateway, double-entry accounting. Ideally you wrote them yourself, and you know what a few cents of error cost at scale.
• 
You have a strong data architecture background.
• 
You can hold the full technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors.
• 
You are a senior engineer with proven results. Team size doesn’t matter – leading 4–5 people is fine.
• 
You know code quality and review still matter, and you are ready to change how the work gets done.
• 
You think and talk like a business person.
• 
You are a mature operator: collaborative, transparent, no “I know best”. You change things carefully and still make bold calls.
• 
Payments or acquiring background is not required – any financial systems experience works.
• 
Nice to have: you have rebuilt or transformed a team before.
• 
Nice to have: you are based in London.

What you get
• 
A new role with a clear mission: transform the platform and the way the company works.
• 
Direct work with the founders, reporting to the CEO.
• 
A team of about 15 engineers to inherit and reshape.
• 
A profitable company moving into Payfac-as-a-Service and embedded distribution.
• 
An AI-native setup where non-engineers build their own tools.
• 
Year 1 is fixed pay. From year 2, shadow equity tied to P&L performance, with a path to real equity. Details to be agreed.

a9e64369a857b09b.description:
Headquarters: California, USA, Remote; New York, USA, Remote; Washington, USA, Remote

Developer Advocates at Datadog are engineers who share their expertise with technical practitioners, help customers tell their stories, and represent the perspectives of our community inside Datadog.

As a Manager II on the Advocacy team, you will lead our Community Advocacy functions. You will manage a team of Developer Advocates responsible for global programs such as Datadog Ambassadors, Champions, and User Groups, as well as opportunities for customer engineers to share their expertise through technical writing, public speaking, and other community contributions.

Across these interconnected programs, your team will enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, lead communities, and turn their experiences into compelling content and conference talks for Datadog and third-party channels. This role combines people leadership, program strategy, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence to amplify authentic customer voices, deepen understanding of Datadog and its products, and foster a thriving community of practitioners.

What You’ll Do: 

• Lead and develop a team of Developer Advocates, setting clear expectations, guiding priorities, coaching performance, supporting career growth, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture

• Own the strategy, goals, and roadmap for Community Advocacy, translating broader Advocacy and company priorities into focused programs and measurable outcomes

• Guide the continued development of our Ambassador, Champion, and User Group programs, creating clear contributor journeys, expectations, enablement, recognition, and opportunities for customer engineers to increase their impact

• Build repeatable systems that enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, create content, share best practices, and serve as trusted leaders within their communities

• Develop a strong pipeline of customer stories by identifying compelling practitioners and helping them shape authentic, technically credible narratives

• Oversee the support, co-development, and coaching of conference talks by customer engineers—from identifying an idea and developing an abstract through content review, rehearsal, and delivery—for Datadog events, including our flagship user conference, DASH, as well as third-party industry conferences

• Establish measures of success for Community Advocacy, using qualitative and quantitative insights to evaluate program health, contributor engagement, content quality, audience impact, and customer outcomes

• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, Customer Success, and regional teams to align priorities, identify opportunities, and scale customer participation across Datadog initiatives

• Ensure insights from Ambassadors, Champions, User Group participants, speakers, and other community members are shared with the appropriate teams inside Datadog, strengthening the connection between our customers and our products

• Balance strategic leadership with selective hands-on contribution, including coaching speakers, reviewing technical content, participating in community programs, and representing Datadog when appropriate

Who You Are: 

• You are an experienced people manager who has led autonomous technical professionals, coached performance, developed talent, and translated complex goals into achievable plans

• You have experience defining and delivering successful developer advocacy, developer relations, technical community, or a related functions

• You have built or meaningfully contributed to programs that enable external practitioners to participate, contribute, create content, or lead communities at scale

• You have experience helping technical practitioners develop and communicate their stories, including coaching conference speakers or co-developing technically credible talks and content

• You are a former software developer, SRE, or other technical practitioner—or have equivalent technical depth—with the judgment needed to assess technical accuracy and coach effective technical narratives

• You are a thoughtful cross-functional leader who can build alignment, make prioritization decisions, and influence partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, and customer-facing organizations

• You use both data and community insight to evaluate program effectiveness, identify opportunities, and make decisions about where the team should invest

• You understand how to build trust with technical communities and value authentic practitioner voices over purely promotional messaging

• You are comfortable operating through ambiguity, establishing structure where needed, and evolving programs as Datadog’s products, customers, and technical audiences grow

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 

Benefits and Growth: 

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

• Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

• An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)

• Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions

• Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+

• Competitive global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

#LI-Remote

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.
The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is:
$212,000—$265,000 USD

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.

This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

a9dd702b9baf0075.description: Equity Research Analyst About the Role As an Equity Research Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in developing proprietary investment theses and providing actionable investment recommendations. This position requires in-depth financial analysis, continuous market monitoring, and a strong focus on assessing downside risks to maximize risk-adjusted returns for our portfolio managers. Key Responsibilities Study company financial statements, earnings reports, and industry trends to build proprietary investment theses. Create detailed Excel models to forecast future earnings, project cash flows, and value target securities. Provide private buy, sell, or hold recommendations directly to portfolio managers, rather than publishing public reports. Track existing investments daily, update financial models after earnings releases, and re-evaluate strategies when market conditions shift. Focus heavily on what can go wrong with an investment, assessing downside risks and helping size portfolio positions to maximize risk-adjusted returns. Maintain continuous coverage of industry-related news, trends, and developments, sharing relevant insights with clients and Partners. Conduct primary research through industry sources and market interactions. Requirements MBA / CA / CFA qualification. Relevant equity research experience. a9dcbe7204d52a65.description: We are seeking a detail-oriented Financial Reporting Analyst to join our team in the Mumbai region. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of financial reporting standards, particularly US GAAP, and will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial statements. As a Financial Reporting Analyst, you will be responsible for preparing and analyzing financial reports, ensuring they meet regulatory requirements and internal standards. You will collaborate with various departments to gather necessary data and provide insights that support strategic decision-making. Your analytical skills will be essential in identifying trends and variances in financial performance, and you will assist in the preparation of budgets and forecasts. Key Responsibilities: - Prepare and review financial statements in accordance with US GAAP. - Analyze financial data to identify trends, variances, and areas for improvement. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data and provide financial insights. - Assist in the preparation of budgets and forecasts. - Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. - Support the audit process by providing necessary documentation and explanations. Required Skills: - Strong knowledge of financial reporting and US GAAP. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. - Proficiency in financial software and Microsoft Excel. - Strong attention to detail and accuracy. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. If you are passionate about financial reporting and are looking for an opportunity to contribute to a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply for this position.
